pairs.subject: invariant-placement
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/types.ts:32 The painter makes 'shared buffer XOR own write callbacks' a shape-level invariant with a discriminated union (ZonePropertyPanel does the same for onCommit XOR record). No negative artifact asserts that passing both is rejected: src/__tests__ has `@ts-expect-error` in only five files, none of them audio. Loosening the union would leave every test green.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/types.ts:32 A raised structural invariant with no artifact whose pass condition is a refusal. The repo-wide ts-expect-error search found no audio or painter fixture.

src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioPropertyPanel/useAudioSetLibrary.ts:69 `clipMs` is declared optional (`clipMs?: number`), yet the emitter defaults an unknown length to 0. The consumer has to decode 0 back into 'not-measured' (audio-event-budget.ts:154). The technique's rule is that an absent optional part is omitted, never defaulted.

src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/constants.ts:16 The sibling map EMITTER_COLORS (line 29) is keyed by `Record<EmitterType, ...>`, so its every-member-has-a-colour rule is enforced by its shape. ZONE_COLORS is keyed by `string`, so the same rule for reverb presets is only covered by the `|| 'var(--text-muted)'` call-site fallback in helpers.ts:8.

src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/useAudioScenePainter.ts:241 ReverbPreset 'none' is a real state that gets produced (every new zone starts with it) and means 'no reverb'. That is the honest exception, not a resolver convenience.

src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/useAudioScenePainter.ts:55 Which zone an emitter belongs to is recomputed by the op reducer (resolveMembership) after every geometry op. No gesture writes it.
src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/useAudioScenePainter.ts:192 The 40-unit minimum is the editor's specified resize behaviour, not a defensive repair of a violated contract.
